findingDetails.title: Malformed mode-registry.json crashes the surfaces check before it can report
findingDetails.case: hub whose mode-registry.json exists but is not valid JSON; JSON.parse throws and the process dies before printing FAIL check surfaces
findingDetails.evidence: parse at verify-doc-claims.cjs:322-324; main calls checks without containment at :396-404; sibling guard wraps every leg at verify-router-sync.cjs:356-361
findingDetails.userImpact: the completion gate still fails via run-all-drift-guards.sh pipefail, but the named check line and fix hint are lost
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n JSON.parse verify-doc-claims.cjs finds this as the only parse site in the script
findingDetails.recommendation: guard the registry read and return a problem string, or wrap the per-check call in try/catch in main

findingDetails.title: Count check cannot flag stale one-surface wording
findingDetails.case: registry declares a count other than one while a doc says one surface or a single surface; the wording is never matched so it is never compared
findingDetails.evidence: COUNT_WORDS covers two..ten at :45; both SURFACE_COUNT_WORDING patterns require those words or 'both' at :46; no one/single/1-surface token exists
findingDetails.userImpact: stale singular wording survives the guard, including the full-removal copy where one-surface prose is most likely
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep -niE one|single surface over the guard returns no vocabulary entry; the change generalized 2->10 but not to 1
findingDetails.recommendation: add one (and optionally single) to COUNT_WORDS and the alternation
findingDetails.confidence: high on behavior, medium on frequency
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a documented decision that singular wording is intentionally out of scope
